claims.text: The hotel is a well-preserved warehouse from the 1800s at the end of Nyhavn.

findings.quote: At the end of the colorful Nyhavn, you will find 71 Nyhavn Hotel; a well-preserved warehouse from the 1800s

claims.text: Junior Suites Deluxe on the 6th floor have slanted ceilings and a sofa bed, and the hotel calls them ideal for small families.

findings.quote: The suites on the 6th floor feature charming slanted ceilings that create an especially cosy atmosphere. These rooms are also ideal for small families, as they are furnished with a comfortable sofa bed.
Our Junior Suites Deluxe are located in the Red Warehouse on either the 1st or 6th floor

claims.text: Alf Arp-Hansen bought the warehouse in 1970 and opened it as a hotel in 1971.

findings.quote: Nyhavn 71 remained in their ownership until 1970 when it was sold to Alf Arp-Hansen.
in 1971 he opened the doors for the first guests

claims.text: Rooms and suites are placed in The Yellow Warehouse and The Red Warehouse.

findings.quote: placed in The Yellow Warehouse and The Red Warehouse

claims.text: The rooms were gently restored with a focus on a timeless Scandinavian expression while preserving the buildings' historic soul.

findings.quote: which has undertaken an exclusive but gentle restoration together with the rest of the hotel. A restoration with focus on a timeless Scandinavian expression and at the same time preserving the historic soul and charm of the buildings.

claims.text: Founder Alf Arp-Hansen made six paintings specifically for the hotel.

findings.quote: He made six paintings specifically for the hotel
painted by the founder and former owner of the hotel, also appears at 71 Nyhavn. Alf Arp- Hansen

claims.text: Kongens Nytorv is a neighbour and the Royal Theatre is around the corner.

findings.quote: With Kongens Nytorv as a neighbor, the Royal Theatre around the corner

claims.text: A walk along the harbour front leads past Amalienborg Palace and Kastellet to the Little Mermaid.

findings.quote: Take a historical journey along the harbor front, stroll past the majestic Amalienborg Palace, experience Northern Europe's best-preserved fortification Kastellet, and end your tour at the Little Mermaid.

claims.text: The concierge team helps with everything from dog sitting and transfers to recommendations.

findings.quote: Our concierge team welcomes you and assists you with everything from dog sitting and transfers to recommendations for the city's best experiences.

claims.text: Guests can rent a bike from the hotel.

findings.quote: Experience Copenhagen on two wheels. Rent a bike from us.

claims.text: Breakfast is included whichever room you choose.

findings.quote: No matter what you choose, you get a breakfast included with your stay.

claims.text: The restaurant and bar, Il Molo, serves a menu of Italian flavours.

findings.quote: Our cozy restaurant and bar, Il Molo, offers an exquisite dining experience with a menu filled with the delicious flavors of Italy.

claims.text: Guests wake up beneath grained beams of Pomeranian pinewood in the preserved warehouse buildings.

findings.quote: wake up beneath grained beams of Pomeranian pinewood that runs, side by side, in our preserved buildings

claims.text: The hotel's art collection is based on the COBRA avant-garde movement, including Asger Jorn's paintings Marche Orange and Compositio.

findings.quote: The art collection of the hotel is based on the European avant-garde movement COBRA
On 71 Nyhavn Hotel you can see Jorn’s well-known paintings, "Marche Orange" and "Compositio".

claims.text: The Suite Deluxe View has French glass doors looking out on the harbour life and The Inner Harbour Bridge.

findings.quote: The French glass doors in the suite invites plenty inflows of light inside and offer you a view of the vivid harbour life and The Inner Harbour Bridge

claims.text: Executive Double Deluxe View rooms sit on the south side of The Red Warehouse, looking over the harbour or the fishing boats in Nyhavn.

findings.quote: placed on the sun-blessed south side in The Red Warehouse and, therefore, offer you a direct view of either the wide harbour or the city life and tied fishing boats in Nyhavn

claims.text: Junior Suites are set across two levels connected by a spiral staircase.

findings.quote: Each suite is individually designed across two levels, connected by a spiral staircase

claims.text: Executive Rooms and Executive Double Deluxe rooms look onto the opposite warehouse, not the water.

findings.quote: Our Executive Rooms, which have a view of the opposite warehouse
In our Executive Double Deluxe Rooms, which have a view of the opposite warehouse

claims.text: In the two-level Junior Suites the bathroom is always on the lower level and may be separated from the sleeping area by a spiral staircase.

findings.quote: The Junior Suites are arranged across two levels. The bathroom is always located on the lower level and may therefore be separated from the sleeping area by a spiral staircase.

claims.text: Parking behind the hotel is limited, though a public parking garage is close by.

findings.quote: 71 Nyhavn Hotel has a limited number of parking spaces behind the hotel, but it is also possible to park in a public parking garage close by.
